summary: 新式焚烧设施可迅速处理废物并回收能源，但长期依赖焚烧可能挤压减量、再利用和回收。文章比较各地垃圾产生量，并以食品浪费和零售做法说明源头减量为何难以落实。

paragraphs.brief: 数个国家令人意外的垃圾处理做法。
sentences: For many years, burning rubbish has been portrayed as the lazy option when it comes to dealing with the problem of waste disposal, since it sends toxic fumes into the air and appears to support a consumerist, throwaway society.
多年来，燃烧垃圾被描述为处理废物处置问题的懒惰选择，因为它向空气中排放有毒烟雾，似乎支持一个消费主义者和抛弃社会。
Norway, however, appears to be burning its way through a sizeable chunk of Europe’s municipal waste, using the heat created by this process to warm and power homes in many of its cities.
然而，挪威似乎正在燃烧着自己的方式，穿过欧洲相当大块城市垃圾，利用这一过程产生的热量来温暖其许多城市的家园，并赋予其动力。
Norway isn’t alone: Germany, Sweden, Belgium and the Netherlands all burn significant quantities of rubbish, and across Europe there are 420 plants burning municipal waste.
挪威并不孤单：德国、瑞典、比利时和荷兰都焚烧了大量垃圾，而且在整个欧洲，有420家工厂焚烧城市垃圾。
With Europe dumping 150 million tonnes of rubbish into landfill* every year, there would seem to be a limitless supply.
欧洲每年向垃圾填埋场倾倒 1.5 亿吨垃圾，因此原料供应看似取之不尽。

paragraphs.brief: 支持垃圾焚烧的多种理由。
sentences: Those who support burning waste say that a new generation of incinerators has made it a more attractive option.
那些支持焚烧废物的人说，新一代的焚化炉使它成为一个更有吸引力的选择。
Filters and scrubbing mechanisms now capture harmful substances such as mercury, hydrochloric acid and heavy metals.
过滤器和洗涤机制现在能够捕捉到汞、盐酸和重金属等有害物质。

According to Ted Michaels, president of the US-based Energy Recovery Centre, ‘There has been constant evolution in combustion engineering and emissions-control technology, and the output from these facilities is now minuscule.’
据美国能源回收中心主席Ted Michaels说，“燃烧工程和排放控制技术不断演变，这些设施的产出现在很小。”
Above all, however, supporters say that incineration is the only way of preventing the long-term impacts of landfill.
然而，支持者们首先指出，焚化是防止填埋场长期影响的唯一办法。
In ten years’ time, says the World Bank, humans will be generating 2.2 billion tonnes of solid waste per year.
世界银行说，十年后，人类每年将产生22亿吨固体废物。
Advocates see incineration as a practical way to deal swiftly with an immediate problem.
倡导者认为焚化是迅速处理当前问题的切实方法。

paragraphs.brief: 来自采用焚烧国家的反对理由。
sentences: Levels of waste generation vary hugely around the world.
世界各地废物的产生水平差别很大。
‘It’s a problem for the developed nations,’ says Joergen Fenhann, a senior scientist working with the UN Environment Programme in Denmark.
Joergen Fenhann是丹麦联合国环境规划署的资深科学家：“这是发达国家的一个问题。”
‘The more you develop, the more you produce, buy and throw away.’
你越发展，你生产、购买和抛弃越多。
But the growth of incineration hasn’t been universally welcomed.
焚化的成长并没有得到普遍欢迎。
Lars Haltbrekken, chairman of Friends of the Earth in Norway, is concerned that incineration plants appear to generate demand for their services.
挪威地球之友主席Lars Haltbrekken担心焚化厂似乎对其服务产生了需求。
‘The problem in Norway,’ he explains, ‘is that we have built too many waste-burning factories.
他解释道，“挪威的问题，是我们建造了太多的废物焚烧工厂。
So we’ve ended up importing waste from other countries.
所以，我们最终从其他国家进口废物。
If you look at this in a very small perspective, it is, of course, better for the climate to burn rubbish from the UK rather than leave it in landfill there,’ he continues.
如果从一个非常小的角度来看看，当然，气候更好地将英国的垃圾焚烧，而不是把它们留在垃圾填埋场"，他继续说。
‘But in a broader perspective, it’s a lazy way of getting rid of waste; you don’t stimulate the goals of reducing, reusing and recycling.’
"但从更广义的角度来看，它是一种懒惰的方式来摆脱废物，你不会刺激减少、再利用和回收的目标。"

paragraphs.brief: 废物处理的新用语反映观念变化。
sentences: Incineration is also at odds with EU policy, which promotes a ‘recycling hierarchy’: ideally, we simply produce less waste in the first place; failing that, we reuse objects more; the next step is recycling; only then should we consider incineration, while dumping in landfill is the last resort.
焚化也与欧盟的政策相矛盾，欧盟的政策提倡“回收等级”:理想的是，我们首先只生产较少的废物；否则，我们更多再利用物体；下一步是回收；只有这样，我们才应该考虑焚化，而倾倒在垃圾填埋场则是最后手段。
Dealing with the problem of waste disposal involves tracing the whole process that took the material from its inception to landfill.
处理废物处置问题涉及追查从材料开始到填埋的整个过程。
We used to call this the ‘cradle to grave’ life cycle; now, the talk is of ‘cradle to cradle’ and an even more comprehensive concept known as ‘zero waste’.
我们常称之为“摇篮到坟墓”的生命周期；现在，谈论的是“摇篮到摇篮”和一个更全面的概念，即“零浪费”。

‘The philosophy of cradle to cradle is about designing products that are actually good for the environment at the end of their life,’ says Joan Marc Simon, European spokesman for the environmental movement GAIA.
环境运动GAIA的欧洲发言人 Joan Marc Simon说：“摇篮到摇篮的理念是设计那些在生命结束时对环境真正有益的产品。”
‘You design a bottle that contains no toxins, is fully recyclable and requires the minimum amount of energy to be produced.’
“你设计一个没有毒素的瓶子，是完全可回收的，需要最低数量的能量才能生产。”
As Simon points out, however, without the right mechanisms in place ‘nothing guarantees that this bottle will end up being properly collected and treated in the appropriate recycling facility’.
然而，正如西蒙指出的，如果没有适当的机制，`没有任何保证保证能够使瓶子最终在适当的回收设施中得到适当的收集和处理 '。

paragraphs.brief: 个人与企业面临的艰难取舍。
sentences: Tim Burns, policy manager at Keep Britain Tidy, says, ‘In the UK alone, people waste £10 billion of food every year.
“让英国保持整洁”组织的政策主管蒂姆·伯恩斯说：“仅在英国，人们每年就浪费价值 100 亿英镑的食物。”
You can argue about composting that, or not buying it in the first place — if you do that, then that’s money the retailers don’t get, so it’s not always clear-cut.’
你可以争论如何堆肥，或者不买它，如果你这样做，那么零售商就得不到钱，所以它并不总是清晰的。
The implications of zero waste are that we’re going to have to take a good long look at those well-stocked supermarket shelves, too.
零废物的影响是，我们也必须仔细研究这些储存良好的超市货架。
‘Supermarkets keep their shelves stocked even when demand isn’t there, which means they have to pay to dispose of a lot of food,’ says Burns.
伯恩斯说，“超市即使没有需求，也保持其货架储备，这意味着他们必须付钱来处理大量的食品，”
‘But that cost is less to them than the cost in brand damage of having empty shelves.’
”但对于他们来说，这种成本比空架子的品牌损坏成本要低。

paragraphs.brief: 过去及未来行为上的根本变化。
sentences: Recent history and changes in trends in recycling suggest that we should be prepared for unexpected developments.
最近的历史和再循环趋势的变化表明，我们应当为意外发展做好准备。
‘If someone back in the 1980s had suggested what waste would be like now, they would be completely wrong,’ says Richard Fisher, a PhD researcher at Cranfield University.
克兰菲尔德大学的博士研究员理查德·费舍尔说：“如果有人在1980年代曾暗示过浪费现在会是什么样子的话。”
‘Consumerism has developed at a pace we never expected.
消费发展的速度是前所未有的。
Nobody would have said there would be so much electronic waste.
没有人会说会有这么多的电子废物。
But recycling has grown, too — ten years ago nobody would have predicted today’s levels of recycling.’
但回收率也有所增长 — — 十年前，没有人会预测今天的回收水平。”
But he points out that the need to reduce waste is still a difficult message to sell to consumers.
但他指出，减少浪费仍然是向消费者销售的一个困难信息。
He suggests that what people are really concerned about is their loved ones and the future they face.
他建议人们真正关心的是他们的亲人和他们面对的未来。
‘Perhaps we can align the environmental message to these deep-seated values,’ he says.
他说：「也许我们可以将环境信息与这些根深蒂固的价值观相匹配。
‘We need to look at whether it’s business that drives consumers or the other way around.
`我们需要看看是企业驱动消费者还是其他方式。
You need government to play a leadership role, whereas countries such as the UK seem to be stepping away from the environment in pursuit of short-term economic goals.’
你需要政府发挥领导作用，而像英国这样的国家似乎正在远离环境，追求短期经济目标。

flow: 从挪威实践看焚烧的两面
新式焚烧炉能快速处理垃圾并回收能源，但设施过大甚至要进口垃圾，使批评者质疑它会不会妨碍减废。
把问题提前到产品设计
讨论从怎样处理垃圾转向怎样减少垃圾，重新设计可循环利用的产品成为另一种出发点。
用食品浪费检验减量的难度
家庭购买和超市补货各有取舍，结尾再由回收行为的历史变化追问，哪些选择和政策能改变未来做法。

items.answer: F · Incineration of waste is now relatively harmless to the environment.
items.solution: 废物焚化目前对环境相对无害。

items.answer: C · Greater consumerism leads to higher levels of waste.
items.solution: 更大的消费主义导致废物的增多。

items.answer: D · Proper systems are needed for the recycling of environmentally-friendly products.
items.solution: 需要适当的系统来回收无害环境的产品。

items.answer: G · Efforts to reduce waste may affect profits for some types of companies.
items.solution: 减少废物的努力可能会影响到某些类型的公司的利润。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 回收环保产品需要运作得当的机制。system 和 mechanism 在这里都指收集、处理产品的整套安排。
题干的“基本价值观”在原文写成“根深蒂固的价值观”，两处都谈如何让环保诉求与之相连。
题干希望政府提供更多指引，原文用“承担领导角色”表达对政府的同一要求。
points: 焚烧常被视为偷懒，挪威等国却大规模采用，强烈反差引出全文争议。
回到对应内容“没有人会说会有这么多的电子废物”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: Those who support burning waste say ….
“that a new generation of incinerators has made it a more attractive option”补足 say 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 say 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
…, it is, of course, better for the climate to burn rubbish from the UK rather than leave it in landfill there,’ he continues.
连接词 if 引出“If you look at this in a very small perspective”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。

随着世界各地垃圾生产量的增加，Mark Rowe问新一代焚烧厂是否能帮助解决问题
